        p_set = set(pieces)
        o_set = set(opp_pieces)
        occupied = p_set | o_set

            # Diagonal moves
            for dc in [-1, 1]:

        # Sort moves for pruning: Wins > Captures > Forward
        # We assign a priority value; lower is better (sorted ascending)
        def move_score(move):

            # Win check
            if t[0] == p_goal:

            # Capture check

                return -1000
            # Forward progress (distance reduction)
            dist = abs(f[0] - p_goal) - abs(t[0] - p_goal)

        moves.sort(key=move_score)

    # Evaluation function
